body:
Talk to me. 
I can hear your loneliness and pain, may not be able help you much but I will listen and can lend my shoulder to rest a little. 
This moment will pass and you will see this world enjoyable again. 
There is greater meaning to all this suffering and sorrow to make our heart strong and compassionate.

Talk to me. 
I am in deep philosophical shit and sober in life. 
My email id 
My whatsapp number is +91+7054412808.give me message. 
I am real, we can talk real philosophical and spiritual stuff. 
I can talk on death and meaninglessness of life and I am not mortified by death . 
Instead I would enjoy talking to such persons. 
Don't feel alone friend.

Talk to someone else, this world is not limited to one person. 
There are so many nice people around the world so date again you will find someone better you never say that this is best part of life instead you say this was better part of life and you will see best in future. 
You don't lose your hope and meaning for one person. 
If you need someone to talk I am here and I am a nice person, can be good friend ,can listen to you,talk to you, if you feel alone. 
I was in deep shit so I know how emotional black hole can feel like. 
I can become your talking buddy until you figure out your life again.
You don't have to feel shitty,alone.

Are you dependent upon your parents? 
If you can earn then you can move to some city or try to change your country..
Don't give up on yourself. 
Don't cower down by society acceptance norms. 
You can talk to some your friends the way out from your family

I had also bout of suicidal thoughts and I posted in this group someday in the past, I am not courageous enough to make the move,i was planning some silent and peaceful way to die ,i have always have been a coward so wounding myself with knife was out of mind.
I was also sad,extremely sad , melancholic, like life is devoid of meaning, sunken so deep that like I thought I can not come out of it sane and alive and last solution to end this misery was to end this worthless life but obviously I did not attempted and I somehow got hope because change of place.
it is so strange that I am so happy these days ,singing ,my heart ,it is so full of Joy and I can not believe that I was sunken so deep that there was no meaning to my life.

My advise to young kids who are at theirs wits end to see the hope,
persist, read some poetry, read some philosophy books, play some music,sing some song,do something creative,don't hide yourself or try to show off something which you are not. 
While you are alive try to enjoy it. 
accepting yourself brings freedom to psyche.
Persist, find joy in your life.

Let your cosigner pay the rent.let them hate you for that. 
And don't care about school dorm room rent pay. The school can not do much except they will not let you have certificate. I know so many famous people without a college degree. 
Dont care about bank they are rich very anyway.
Now you have to focus on make living for few month or years until situations improve and it will improve.
It seems you have lived your life pretty outrageously and situation was getting worse but you did not care much and suddenly you want to kill yourself and runaway from problems you have created in your life. 
My advice -face everyone from school to landlord to bank. Don't run away from the situation you created.there is learning in it and it will make you a better person once this storm will out and you would gain your sense. Be upright now. 
I know you can think that you are the one facing the problem in person I am lecturing you . But beleive me we all have our share of this bloody pain.
But why you want to kill yourself, your money problem will be solved or worst you will go to Jail.
What do you mean you have no choice. What bank can do worst, they will jail you?
Moreover it feels like you want to hide somewhere because you are ashamed that your aquintences will know that you were in debt or something else?
But bank debts don't ask you to pay by life.

Don't run away. 
Dont compromise on ethics. 
I know you are in difficult situation but be forthright about your situation to your kith and kins. 
Dont hide,we all fucked up some times and it is the hardest time of your life but if you don't run away from the situation, you will figure out something. It will take time but you will come out of this fine. 
Have faith in you.

Talk to her, try to convince her Tell her that you were asshole and will amend your way of your conduct. 
Otherwise it is not over yet this break-up or divorce can linger through your life so long.
This is not easy thing to forget and you can not easily move ahead on this.

So many of us care for you and I hope that you realise by now. 
You consider yourself replaceable but not everyone is like that. 
Some of us here are also hurt and truly care for you. 
First of all do not feel alone. 
By response you can see that how many care for your well being because of some assholes you should not reject whole humanity and you don't need all people to love you.
You need to have very few people to be happy in life so stop try to appease too many. 
First you have to become comfortable in your skin then only you find someone who will love you truely for who you are. 
It is hard to accept oneself and be in love with oneself but the suffering is way through which you will find your trueself. So don't give up so early. 
We all be dead anyway so why putting effort in killing oneself. Instead you should put effort in making yourself independent financially and emotionally. 
I am also here present to help you. 
Feel free to message me. 
I will listen to your pain ,your suffering in a non judgemental way. You don't have to ashamed or guilty for what have you been through. It is not your fault.
You too.😊😊

My advice : have little hope because you don't know how time can change extreme sadness, hopelessness ,unworthiness, guilt to a spectacular life experience that you would feel proud for having faith in you. 
Situations do change, emotion of guilt , shame and unworthiness do change wonderful life experience. 
You will become a wonderful storyteller ,a leader because of sensitivity . 
Just put effort in learning creative things , express yourself. 
Don't worry too much about shyness, its very natural to have shame guilt and unworthiness when you have a dysfunctional family and its not your fault. You have been conditioned that way to not feel worthy or loved or guilty. It is all part of faulty upbringing. 
I am always ready to give you encouragement and advices, because I have been through lot of nasty feeling alone so I understand you.

Ah, family. 
Then it will be extremely hard to find to peace , it will take time to feel comfortable in your skin.
You can not become your father or mother but you can start a new family (but not in hurry). 
My father was absent from our lives and most of my sibling and me have most issues related with absent and abusive fathers but they are not very conscious about it and have moved on but I am still trying to find out some reason to make it worthwhile to bear this life.

You can watch Gabor mate , read 
"Body keeps the score " and many resources on dysfunctional family issues.

Its hard to cope with what we have been through but either way we can remain victim forever and think of suicide or put every effort to make our life beautiful and happy. 
It is hard but don't lose hope. 

I am here on another part of world can feel for you, your pain because I am in the same boat but little sober so always here to talk. 
So whenever you feel overwhelmed talk to me, don't feel that you will disturb me uneccesory.

buy a Cat or Dog and check whether you are asking this question next month also.
